messages:
Mira: Pushing a short proposal — add a 'weight_tranche' primitive to runtime configs so we can shift traffic by weight tiers based on quota/latency signals. Goal: safer, incremental switchovers from cheap pools -> premium GPU pools without big blasts.

Sam: sketch the API? is this a new field on route config or a separate resource? :thinking: 

Mira: new field on route config, loosely: `weight_tranches: [{percent:10, max_qps:100, conditions: {...}}, ...]` so route picks the highest tranche that matches and has capacity. allows multiple tranches w/ different backends.

Sam: can you paste a tiny example? easier to reason about with real shape.

Mira: sure — rough prototype:

```json
{
  "route": "/generate",
  "weight_tranches": [
    {"percent": 10, "backend": "gpu-premium", "max_qps": 50},
    {"percent": 30, "backend": "gpu-standard", "max_qps": 200},
    {"percent": 60, "backend": "cpu-burst", "max_qps": 1000}
  ]
}
```

Jonathan: telemetry thoughts: we need events for tranche_evaluation, tranche_selected, tranche_capacity_exhausted, plus a gauge for effective_percent per-route. otherwise ops won't see silent shifts. also surface latency p50/p95 per-backend when tranche flips.

Leila: ops concerns — how do we abort? need an emergency_pause flag and an automatic fallback policy: if selected backend latency > threshold OR errors > 3% for 2m then revert request to next tranche and emit alert. Also max_rollout_rate so we can't go 0->100 by accident.

Mira: agree. thinking of adding fields: `emergency_pause: true|false`, `fallback_order: [..]`, `max_rollout_delta_per_minute`.

Sam: API/validation: we should reject configs where all tranches point to same backend with overlapping percent ranges. also ensure percent sums <=100. validation should be server-side with clear error to console.

Carol (UX): console surface idea: show a stacked bar for current tranches with hover for backend perf and a small preview simulator where you can run `n` synthetic requests to see expected backend distribution. also expose an instant revert button and history diff.

Jonathan: also recommend a dry-run mode that simulates tranche selection in shadow and emits metrics to a dryrun prefix for 24h before activation. lets SRE/owners QA distribution without impacting live traffic.

Leila: rollout plan: start with tenant-scoped opt-in + slow ramp (max_rollout_delta 5% per 10m) + mandatory dry-run for first 3 usages of the primitive. ops can auto-block if SSE (service error rate) spikes.

Mira: implementation notes: runtime needs fast evaluation: tranche checks should be O(1) tier selection plus atomic counters for qps per-tranche. we'll reuse existing prefix/KV cache hooks. we must avoid per-request RPCs for capacity checks.

Sam: what about testing? unit tests for selector logic + integration test injecting synthetic latency and verifying fallback chain works. also add a chaos test where backend becomes unreachable.

ops-bot: reminder: add a runbook entry under eng-oncall/playbooks -> "tranche-routing emergency revert" when config lands.

Leila: action items: (1) Mira to draft RFC with API + validation rules, (2) Jonathan to list telemetry events and dashboard mockups, (3) Carol to prototype console mock, (4) Sam to outline unit/integration test plan, (5) Leila to draft runbook changes. target: RFC in 1 week.

Sam: +1 on timeline. I'll pair on validation rules.

Jonathan: I'll add a suggested Prometheus / trace schema to the RFC.

Carol (UX): I'll drop a Figma link in thread tomorrow.

Mira: thanks all — I'll post the RFC link here once it's up. :thumbsup:
